findings.issue: `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_of_spectatorPlane`, `apply_p_eq_zero_of_spectatorPlane`, `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_right_of_spectatorPlane`, `apply_p_eq_zero_right_of_spectatorPlane` (lines 213, 220, 227, 233) restate the conclusions of the dimension-free `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero`/`apply_p_eq_zero` and their `_right` variants (lines 171, 188, 197, 205). summary: Two levels are off: the only construction of a parity-odd `A` is pinned to `Fin 4 → ℝ` though its proof is basis-generic, so no abstract four-dimensional space can instantiate the headline theorem; and the four annihilation corollaries are stated twice under two hypothesis bundles with neither family used.
